title: Confucius visits Zhou to ask Laozi about rites
timeLabel: Traditional account: late Spring and Autumn period; date uncertain
shortSummary: The Shiji preserves Confucius's visit to Laozi in Zhou as an early historiographical entry into a Dao–Ru encounter.
curatorialDescription: This is a textually located tradition, not a recoverable verbatim transcript of a meeting. It is useful for showing how later historiography places two figures within one spatial and speech relationship.
researchNote: The Shiji provides the historiographical layer. The capital's exact site, meeting date and farewell sayings remain marked as traditional rather than uncontested fact.
